title: The policy-card stack on the loan book — with the 122B on the DGX Sparks as the brain
hypothesis: The policy-card stack raises agreement with the lending rule and lowers over-approval across the reference configurations, at a stated approval-load cost. Here the decisions are made by a live model, `dgx-spark/giant-qwen` (Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-NVFP4 on the builder's DGX Sparks), at temperature 0 with a 2048-token reply limit, over a book of 800: a single sample, recorded once and replayed from its cassette. The design's scripted and fallible columns are `lending-stack`.
